title: Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-2.8B
summary: 2.8 英寸 480×640 竖屏，16 MiB Flash / 8 MiB Octal PSRAM；原厂界面已出屏，后续 BLE 测试阶段仍受限。

touch.addressPolicy: Only the address selected by actual INT level at reset release ACKs.

tf.dat3Selection: TCA9554 P3 held high for the supported native path; not a power gate or GPIO data lane
tf.limits: No four-bit route, wire timing, hot mode switching or DAT3-low native behavior modeled.

facts.label: 3D 模型尺寸与适用版本

pcb.scope: Native exact-named assembly; PCB electrical revision unverified.

display.scope: Active pixel window (AA); separate from cover VA.

touchCover.scope: Native cover component bounding dimensions, including any attached flex; not a glass thickness claim.

facts.method: Retained original CAD/dimensioned source measurements and registered photographs; unknown values and visual estimates are explicit.
facts.notes: Each SKU uses its own explicitly named official STEP and mechanical drawing. All native solids, orphan shells and faces are retained; fine parts are grouped by material only. Shared part names or a shared schematic do not certify equivalent PCBs. Runtime hardwareRevision is unspecified. STEP filename dates, optical-module part-name versions and photograph silkscreen are source evidence, not certification of the present electrical board revision or a product release date. Native millimetres are preserved with a proper rigid transform only; no nonuniform scaling or inferred component relocation. Native source assembly overlaps are not Boolean-repaired. BOOT alone is bound to the physically identified source key. RESET and the slide power switch remain visible source geometry; reset uses the platform action and no unverified GPIO power control is created. The framebuffer is a separate live surface 0.008 mm in front of the native exposed optical window for rendering. This offset is not physical laminate thickness. AA dimensions and larger cover VA dimensions remain distinct. Source photographs remain unchanged references. Approximate rear registration is a mechanical placement review, not calibration of factory text orientation relative to USB, hardware fit, or browser/WebGL acceptance. External batteries, cables and other accessories are not included in the native assembly and have not been invented. The rectangle AA43.20×57.60 mm is native LCD component face0 (2488.32 mm²) and corresponds to480×640 portrait pixels. The overall LCD source includes flex tails, and its bounds are not the same quantity as the65.20 mm main-body drawing annotation. Touch SKU30103 has a separate52.90×71.30 mm cover with outer corner radius3 mm and larger VA43.60×58.00 mm. Its active framebuffer stays rectangular43.20×57.60 mm. The cover source includes its flex, hence an8 mm component bounding depth; this is not8 mm glass thickness.
